newsitem.title: USA: Nellcor Puritan says waiting period ends.
newsitem.headline: Nellcor Puritan says waiting period ends.

text.p: Nellcor Puritan Bennett Inc said Thursday the waiting period for a government review of its merger with Aequitron Medical Inc has expired.

The proxy statement for the meeting of Aequitron shareholders to approve the deal will be mailed on or about Nov. 1, 1996. The merger is expected to close following the meeting of shareholders on Dec. 5, the company said.

Aequitron makes electronic respiratory products for home health care and hospital use, wheelchair lifts and automobile hand controls. Nellcor Puritan makes products that monitor, diagnose and treat respiratory-impaired patients.
